notes: Draft configuration: The operator 2021 East participant map identifies the 3.93 km, 22-corner circuit with its own straight and two closing junctions. The complete public-road snapshot supplies the northern link 1091735177 and southern link 1091735178, both mapped as private service roads. These exact nodes join the northern circuit to the middle straight and that straight to the inner southern course, avoiding the two longer International-route junction spurs. The full northern loop, eastern outer curves, southern front straight, inner southern hairpin and shorter southern return remain. Independent September 22, 2026 Sentinel imagery confirms the separate paved links. The main West course, pit lane, paddock and both longer International junction spurs are excluded. The independently measured 3,907.7 m differs from the supplied and published 3,930 m without scaling. Historical alignment and travel direction remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3907.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
